# Martial Athletic

> Premium fitness platform for creating, sharing, and competing with workout programs. Train harder, compete smarter.

Martial Athletic helps gyms and athletes run competitions end-to-end: registration,
divisions, workouts, judging, leaderboards, brackets, heats, and seasons.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and entry point.
- [How It Works](/guide): Detailed guide to competitions, divisions, scoring, brackets, heats, and lifecycle.
- [Sign Up](/register): Create an athlete or affiliate account.
- [Log In](/login): Sign in to manage competitions or compete.
- [Browse](/browse): Discover programs, competitions, and gear.

## Optional

- [Tutorial](/tutorial): Step-by-step walkthrough for new users.
